import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, GridSearchCV
from scipy import sparse
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

classes = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
label_map = {cls: i for i, cls in enumerate(classes)}
num_classes = len(classes)

X_text = train_df["text"].fillna("")
X_text_test = test_df["text"].fillna("")
y_train_encoded = train_df["author"].map(label_map).values.astype(int)

# Word-level TF-IDF with unigrams and bigrams
vectorizer_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=5000, stop_words="english", sublinear_tf=True
)
word_train = vectorizer_word.fit_transform(X_text)
word_test = vectorizer_word.transform(X_text_test)

# Character n-gram TF-IDF (3-5 grams - more appropriate for text)
vectorizer_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    max_features=50000,
    lowercase=True,
)
char_train = vectorizer_char.fit_transform(X_text)
char_test = vectorizer_char.transform(X_text_test)

# Properly stack sparse features using scipy.sparse.hstack
X_train_full = sparse.hstack([word_train, char_train])
X_test_full = sparse.hstack([word_test, char_test])

print(f"Train full shape: {X_train_full.shape}, Test full shape: {X_test_full.shape}")

# Stratified hold-out validation set - model will NOT train on this split
X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train_val, y_val_enc = train_test_split(
    X_train_full,
    y_train_encoded,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_encoded,
)

print(f"Training samples: {len(X_train_split)}, Validation samples: {len(X_val_split)}")

# Grid search over regularization strength C
param_grid = {"C": [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0]}

model = LogisticRegression(multi_class="auto", max_iter=2000, solver="lbfgs")
grid_search = GridSearchCV(
    model, param_grid, cv=5, scoring="neg_log_loss", refit=True, verbose=0, n_jobs=-1
)
grid_search.fit(X_train_split, y_train_val)

best_params = grid_search.best_params_
print(f"Best Parameters: C={best_params['C']}")

best_model = grid_search.best_estimator_


def compute_log_loss(probabilities, true_labels):
    """Compute official multi-class log loss as specified in competition instructions"""
    N = len(true_labels)
    M = num_classes

    p_clipped = np.clip(probabilities, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

    # Normalize probabilities row-wise to sum to 1 (compulsory per instructions)
    row_sums = p_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    p_norm = p_clipped / row_sums

    # Handle zero sums case if any
    if p_norm.sum(axis=1).min() == 0:
        p_norm[p_norm.sum(axis=1) == 0] = 1 / M

    # One-hot encode true labels
    y_one_hot = np.zeros((N, M))
    y_one_hot[np.arange(N), true_labels] = 1

    # Compute log loss per the competition formula
    neg_loss = -(p_norm * np.log(p_norm))
    log_loss = float(-np.mean(np.sum(y_one_hot * neg_loss, axis=1)))

    return log_loss


# Validate score on held-out validation set
val_pred_proba = best_model.predict_proba(X_val_split)
valid_score = compute_log_loss(val_pred_proba, y_val_enc)
print(f"Validation Log Loss (hold-out): {valid_score:.6f}")

# Predictions on full test set for submission
test_pred_proba = best_model.predict_proba(X_test_full)

# Create submission file matching sample format
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "EAP": [float(p[0]) for p in test_pred_proba],
        "HPL": [float(p[1]) for p in test_pred_proba],
        "MWS": [float(p[2]) for p in test_pred_proba],
    }
)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved successfully!")
